## Use in project chats / coding work

When given a canonical Drive project URL or repository:

1. mount the source project;
2. resolve local START/HANDOFF/AGENTS first;
3. compare revision against prior harvest;
4. map artifacts to existing global kernel/ABI objects;
5. extract only qualified deltas;
6. produce a project-local FeedbackPacket rather than silently rewriting source canon;
7. compile a mission Holotope / Archetonic Plate for actual work.

For code work, prefer the pinned ABI primitives over ad-hoc cross-project naming.
